## Description
This addon can warn you if you character is AFK.

[![Screenshot1](./.github/media/afk_01t.jpg)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HizurosWoWAddOns/AFK_Fullscreen/master/.github/media/afk_01.jpg)  [![Screenshot2](./.github/media/afk_02t.jpg)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HizurosWoWAddOns/AFK_Fullscreen/master/.github/media/afk_02.jpg)

* Fullscreen blinking orange like blizzards low health warning
* It can hide the UI on AFK
* The info panel displaying the time since AFK and something more
* The info panel look is changable (skin support)
